modification_description: The agent accepts the harm-prevention synthesis but requests it be made explicitly contingent and enforceable, adding: (1) no-go conditions for heavy rain or high-risk scenarios requiring indoor confinement or leashed distance from boundaries; (2) high-reliability physical containment measures such as fenced muddy play areas, tarps/runners near boundaries, or portable pens rather than relying solely on post-play cleaning; (3) an immediate paw-and-muzzle cleanup protocol with supplies kept ready before approaching shared areas or boundaries; and (4) a clear written neighbor agreement specifying boundaries, permitted times, and cleanup responsibilities to prevent recurring disputes.
